scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,admin,website -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:website"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:admin && npm run build:website
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../website && npm install
